signal: Seso closed a $26M Series B led by BOND to expand its ag-workforce platform with AI payroll and a comprehensive HR suite, and was named a Fast Company Most Innovative Company in 2025

email.body1:
Daniel, saw Seso's $26M Series B from BOND and the push into AI payroll and a full HR suite for agribusiness.

Scaling that fast usually means more mid-market farms in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Seso off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Daniel, quick follow-up for Seso.

Post-Series B, the pipeline expectation on mid-market sales climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your segment needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Daniel, last bit of proof for Seso.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Seso's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B vertical SaaS startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Daniel, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling mid-market pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The post-raise sprint to expand the platform is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a mid-market motion? I'll tailor it to Seso either way.
